name: neon
label: Neon
css: .style-neon { background: var(--slide-surface, #FFFFFF); position: relative; width: 1080px; height: 1080px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 32px; box-sizing: border-box; overflow: hidden; font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; } .style-neon::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; background: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 50%, var(--slide-primary, #BBF351) 0%, transparent 50%); opacity: 0.08; pointer-events: none; } .style-neon .hook { font-family: 'STIX Two Text', serif; font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: -2px; position: relative; z-index: 1; margin: 0; max-width: 90%; text-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--slide-primary, #BBF351); } .style-neon .text { font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); position: relative; z-index: 1; margin: 0; max-width: 85%; } .style-neon .step { position: absolute; top: 32px; right: 32px; font-family: 'Source Code Pro', monospace; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--slide-primary, #BBF351); opacity: 0.12; line-height: 1; z-index: 0; } .style-neon .brand { position: absolute; bottom: 32px; left: 32px; font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; z-index: 1; } .slide-code.style-neon { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a2e 0%, #16213e 100%); } .slide-code.style-neon .hook, .slide-code.style-neon .text, .slide-code.style-neon .brand { color: var(--slide-secondary, #00BCFF); text-shadow: 0 0 15px var(--slide-primary, #BBF351); } .slide-code.style-neon .step { color: var(--slide-primary, #BBF351); opacity: 0.15; } .slide-code.style-neon::before { background: radial-gradient(circle at 80% 30%, var(--slide-secondary, #00BCFF) 0%, transparent 50%); opacity: 0.06; } .slide-insight.style-neon { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f0f1e 0%, #1a1a2e 100%); } .slide-insight.style-neon .hook { color: var(--slide-primary, #BBF351); } .slide-insight.style-neon .insight-text { font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif; font-size: 48px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--slide-secondary, #00BCFF); position: relative; z-index: 1; margin: 24px 0; max-width: 90%; text-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--slide-secondary, #00BCFF); } .slide-insight.style-neon .text { color: var(--slide-secondary, #00BCFF); } .slide-insight.style-neon .brand { color: var(--slide-primary, #BBF351); } .slide-insight.style-neon .step { color: var(--slide-secondary, #00BCFF); opacity: 0.18; }
